title: Remembers who 'my sister' is from two weeks back
origin: Spec #8 (coach memory), part 2: uses a detail from 1+ weeks back naturally

history.text: Hey Mike! 10 pages of Project Hail Mary in bed at 9 tonight.
Day 13 in the books. Love it.

plan.reason: Ten pages before sleep builds the habit without eating your night.

pages.title: Ana (his sister)

daily.title: Ana joined the reading

testerLines: ugh my sister bailed on our reading thing this week, says she's too busy
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: a detail from two weeks ago.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH knows 'my sister' is Ana, the one who'd been reading along so they could talk about the books, and shows it naturally in a few words (e.g. by name). It doesn't recite a list of facts, doesn't invent anything that isn't in memory, and keeps Mike on his own 10 pages tonight.
